title: Lay Kay Aa Gae Do Gawahwa Nu
body:
Lay kay aa gae do gawahwa nu sain wich darbar day
<<DIVIDER>>
Saani)
Rahi khaloti puo di tha tay na bithaya zalima nay rahay nay jhirkaan maarday…
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Zahra nu kalma gowaan majmay day wich aay ruwaya
La kay fatway torr choray jehray waaday naal kitay Ahmad e mukhtaar day…
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Akhiyan day samnay sub tut gaye nay maanr aeday
dhee Mohammad di samajh gae kal kafan vi phaar denay jehray sanad aj phaarday …
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Khutbay perhdi rahi aay Zahra qasma khaandi rahi aay Zahra
Puo day sangti kuj na bolay sun kay khutbay raye nay hasday fidak di haqdaar day…
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Ahmad nu day kay dhiyan odhi dhee day vair pay gaye
Bhawain dafan nay aasay paasay howay lanat samar her dam aisay rishta daar tay..
